title: Repeat-Level Returned Payment Fees: Crediting Basis, Crestline Credit Card
content:
For Northgate's returned-fee courtesy credit on the Crestline Credit Card, the returned-fee credit basis depends on the level the fee was charged at: when the fee was charged at the repeat amount (the product's repeat returned payment fee) and no returned payment fee besides it was posted fewer than 3 months before today, the part of the fee above the first-violation amount (the product's first returned payment fee) is credited outright and the share of the returned payment fee that the courtesy credit returns is applied to the first-violation amount; when the fee was charged at the repeat amount and another returned payment fee was posted fewer than 3 months before today, nothing is credited outright and that share is applied to the first-violation amount only; otherwise nothing is credited outright and that share is applied to the whole fee.

On every Crestline Credit Card product the repeat amount is 41 USD and the first-violation amount 30 USD; the part above is 11 USD.

| Fee charged at | Another returned payment fee fewer than 3 months before today | Credited outright | Share applied to |
|---|---|---|---|
| 41 USD (repeat) | no | 11 USD | 30 USD |
| 41 USD (repeat) | yes | nothing | 30 USD only |
| any other amount | any | nothing | the whole fee |

The credit is the part credited outright plus the share of the amount it is applied to.

## Cases (hypothetical share of 0.5)

- 41 USD fee, no other returned payment fee in 3 months: 11 USD plus 15 USD, 26 USD.
- 41 USD fee, another 6 weeks earlier: 15 USD.
- 30 USD fee: 15 USD.
